en: This is a black-and-white vintage postcard depicting a rural village scene. The foreground shows a road with people, horse-drawn carriages, and a fence. The main building has a sign reading 'Gostiona Bratovština' and another sign on the building says 'Vila Horvat.' The area is surrounded by hills and vegetation, and several smaller houses are visible in the background. There is outdoor seating in front of the main building, indicating it may be a guesthouse or inn.
